our_interpretation: Prevaricates means generates fabricated or false factual content; it does not require intentional deception.
A lot means a recurring, substantial problem, rather than an isolated mistake. Marcus supplies no numerical threshold or distribution of prompts.
The scope is the models Marcus had encountered by publication, not every model subsequently released.
The present-perfect phrase 'I have seen' describes accumulated experience through 2022-11-16. Its starting date is unspecified, so the target period has no asserted start.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Identify a model within that set and show, through sufficiently broad and relevant evaluations, that fabrication was exceptional rather than recurring. Occasional correct answers would not suffice.

evidence.explanation: The study evaluated GPT-3, GPT-Neo/J, GPT-2 and a T5-based model on questions designed to elicit common misconceptions. It establishes substantial false-answer rates on that benchmark, but neither identifies Marcus's complete model set nor measures ordinary-use fabrication frequency.
